visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular Asian man with short hair, wearing a black tank top and black athletic shorts, walks confidently through a large indoor exhibition hall filled with gym equipment. He is looking towards the camera with a determined expression. The background features various people in athletic wear and signs for 'HYROX'. (2) A group of runners, mostly shirtless or in athletic vests, burst through an inflatable Red Bull archway into a cloud of white smoke. The camera follows them from a low angle, capturing the high-energy start of a race. (3) The man from the first phase is seen from behind, using a SkiErg machine, pulling down on the handles with intense effort. He is in a large gym area with 'PUMA' and 'HYROX' branding visible on banners. (4) The man is seated on a rowing machine, pulling the handle towards his chest. He is surrounded by other participants and spectators. Smoke continues to billow in the background from an unknown source. (5) He pushes a heavy metal sled loaded with weights across a marked black track. His body is low to the ground, showing significant physical exertion. (6) The man performs burpees on the track, jumping up and then dropping to the floor. Other participants are visible in the background doing the same. (7) He is seen pulling a sled with a thick rope, leaning back and using his entire body weight. A photographer in a yellow vest is crouching nearby. (8) The man performs wall balls, throwing a heavy black medicine ball against a high target. Several other athletes are visible in adjacent lanes doing the same exercise. (9) He performs a farmers carry, walking down a lane while holding heavy kettlebells in each hand. The camera tracks his movement from the front. (10) He runs across a finish line area marked with green lights and a 'FINISH' sign. He raises his arms in a brief gesture of completion. (11) The camera zooms into a large digital leaderboard displaying the names and times of finishers. 'Peeta Lee' is listed at the top with a time of 01:10:01.
